source: mmRadarPose trial p1_an0_ac4_r0 with an AMASS-like base-SMPL sequence
note: Limited example adapted from mmRadarPose trial p1_an0_ac4_r0 at frame 000240.

evaluation_notes.po_human_only: Use amass_sequence.npz and the packaged empty environment.
evaluation_notes.shape: The distributed motion uses neutral gender and zero betas; it is not participant-specific shape.

motion.mesh_generation: generated from the AMASS parameters and a separately licensed SMPL model when simulation is run
motion.parameter_source: poses, translations, timing, topology, and producer fields come from the selected fitted sequence; betas and gender were neutralized for release

timing_fields.times: Original selected-window source times in seconds.
timing_fields.source_capture_times: Absolute source capture times in seconds.
timing_fields.bundle_times: Times relative to the selected radar frame, which is t=0.
